name: agent-ledger
title: Agent ledger
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Changes an agent already made, with the later changes that revert too and the ones that have to stay.

meta.descriptionEs: Lo que un agente ya cambió, qué se revierte con ello y qué no se puede recoger.

examples.title: Libro del pedido
examples.description: Precio, borrador, factura enviada y una nota que se queda.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Vacío, textos largos, RTL y una cadena de diez cambios.

api.name: changes
api.description: id, summary, system, before, after, note, at, reversible, follows. meta is opaque. Newest shows first.

api.name: onUndo / onRedo
api.description: The change and the later reversible changes that go with it.

api.name: undone / pointedId
api.description: Controlled undone ids, and a row lit as if its undo were pointed at.

api.name: loading / error
api.description: Loading skeleton, or an alert when the log cannot be read.

api.name: labels
api.description: Chrome copy, including relative time. English is the default.

docs: Inspirado en el comportamiento público de un libro de cambios con deshacer; reimplementación clean-room; no código, datos, iconos ni assets de Affect. Si el CLI pregunta si debe sobrescribir un primitivo que el anfitrión ya tiene (badge, button, skeleton), responde no. La pieza no trae tema, cssVars ni colores fijos.
